result.summary: The intersection is located under a large overpass and features a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk with a curb ramp. Pedestrian safety is compromised by the wide crossing distance and potential sightline obstructions caused by the massive bridge pillars.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Bridge Pillar
hazards.description: The large concrete pillar of the overpass may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, adjacent to the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance while crossing the multi-lane roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, across the marked crosswalk.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The environment is dominated by high-capacity roadway infrastructure under massive highway overpasses, creating a hostile space for pedestrians. There are no marked crossings or pedestrian signals visible, despite the presence of a paved path on the left side of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks across the wide multi-lane road, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from infrastructure
hazards.description: Large concrete bridge piers create blind spots where pedestrians and drivers may not see each other.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center background where the overpass supports meet the ground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with continental or ladder patterns to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image depicts a paved multi-use path or sidewalk running parallel to a river and under a large bridge structure. While the path itself is in good condition and separated from the roadway, signage explicitly prohibits pedestrians from crossing at this location, directing them elsewhere.

hazards.name: Prohibited Crossing Area
hazards.description: Signage indicates pedestrians are not allowed to cross at this point, implying high-speed or high-volume traffic on the adjacent roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground on the sign post

interventions.title: Enhanced Wayfinding
interventions.description: Provide clear, high-visibility signage and markings to the nearest safe crossing point.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a well-maintained multi-use path separated from a multi-lane roadway by a grass buffer. While a marked crosswalk and traffic signals are present, the large bridge pier creates a significant visual obstruction for pedestrians and drivers at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A massive concrete bridge pier significantly blocks the sightlines between pedestrians entering the crosswalk and oncoming motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the frame, adjacent to the crosswalk entrance

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration without a median or physical traffic calming encourages higher vehicle speeds at a pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Modify signal timing to give pedestrians a head start, making them more visible to turning vehicles before the vehicle green phase begins.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the curb at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past the bridge pier obstruction.
